_comment: SessionStart stdout IS shown to Claude, so this injects live repo state into context at the start of every session. Cheaper and always-current versus writing it in CLAUDE.md.

hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; echo '--- repo state ---'; echo "branch: $(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null)"; echo 'recent commits:'; git log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null; echo 'uncommitted files:'; git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | head -20; exit 0
